pr_body:
Motivation:

We need to detect CNAME loops during lookup the DnsCnameCache as otherwise we may try to follow cnames forever.

Modifications:

- Correctly detect CNAME loops in the cache
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/10220
pr_title: Detect CNAME loops in the CNAME cache while trying to resolve
pr_comment: @slandelle I think it should be good enough as `A` would be in the `Set` and so we would break. What I am missing ?
My bad, indeed, I had missed the check on the boolean returned by add.
Then, your call: perfect solution at the cost of extra HashSet allocation vs loop limit without extra allocation?
@slandelle lets keep the set for now...we can add extra options later on. We only need the set if we have more then 2 links in the chain anyway
Can also consider this loop detection algorithm: https://github.com/google/guava/blob/48c7cfd5e38c8492e4356aab5c633254d1ce43be/guava/src/com/google/common/base/Throwables.java#L255
